objective: Continue the explicit P-256 horizontal isogeny search and test every newly retained depth-44/45 curve for a reproducible Pollard-rho iteration-rate advantage.

acceptance_interpretation.reporting_rule: Report measured ratios and confidence intervals without independently labeling a ratio dramatic.
acceptance_interpretation.screening_trigger: An unadjusted paired 95% interval whose lower bound exceeds 1.0 selects a candidate for fresh holdout only.
acceptance_interpretation.reproduction_gate: A fresh 30-trial, two-second holdout paired against P-256 must also have a 95% interval whose lower bound exceeds 1.0.
acceptance_interpretation.end_to_end_gate: Any reproduced advantage must retain exact log transport, separately measure complete-path evaluation on P and Q, charge per-key mapping, and pass the repository CPU-isolation gate.
acceptance_interpretation.full_p256_collision: not required; correctness uses native scalar-relation invariants and existing completed toy collisions

prior_positive_separation_rule: Deeper candidate discovery does not supersede or resolve any of the six isolated-host follow-ups.

class_wide_endomorphism_order_certificat.volcano_consequence: There are no vertical levels; every rational low-degree edge retained by this protocol is horizontal at level zero.
class_wide_endomorphism_order_certificat.audit_rule: Record both the Frobenius-order conductor and curve endomorphism-ring conductor for every candidate; reject any value other than 1 or any nonhorizontal path edge.

search.deduplication: j-invariant within the frontier run and candidate ID against the frozen prior retained union
required_candidate_evidence: kernel polynomial and rational map for every edge
transported P-256 generator and prime-order check
volcano level 0 and horizontal classification for every path edge

native_screen.implementation: same fixed-limb Montgomery-field rho binary for P-256 and every candidate
native_screen.baseline: fresh P-256 row in every block
native_screen.correctness: tracked scalar relation verified after every timed trial
native_screen.multiplicity: unadjusted intervals are selection triggers, never final evidence

fresh_holdout.population: every unadjusted screening hit, with no discretionary pruning
fresh_holdout.baseline: P-256 in the same complete timing-position rotations
fresh_holdout.correctness: tracked scalar relation verified after every timed trial

typed_transfer.map: composition of explicit F_p-rational separable isogenies and recorded model isomorphisms
typed_transfer.kernel_intersection: trivial because n is prime and differs from every edge degree
typed_transfer.log_transport: Q = kP implies phi(Q) = k phi(P); destination logarithm is the same k modulo n
typed_transfer.recovery: no inverse point map is needed to recover k

per_key: evaluation of the complete retained path on P
evaluation of the complete retained path on Q
cost_accounting.per_iteration: matched native Pollard-rho iterations per second
cost_accounting.unsuccessful_attempts: retain failures, timeouts, zero-yield runs, and nonreproducing hits
cost_accounting.amortization: report reusable discovery separately and never hide per-key mapping

publication_storage.format: one deterministic gzip byte stream split into ordered 50331648-byte shards; level 9, empty filename, mtime 0
required_evidence: SHA-256 and byte count for every shard
concatenated compressed SHA-256 and byte count
exact materialization before any later frontier extension
publication_storage.publication_rule: Publish the shards and manifest, not the oversized working JSON; concatenate shards in manifest order before decompression and retain every explicit path byte-for-byte.

resources.host_isolation: unverified; timing remains exploratory unless rerun through the repository isolation service

commands.search: docker exec --workdir /repo/experiments/p256-isogeny-search-20261005 p256-classgroup-default taskset -c 2 sage -python scripts/extend_sage_low_degree.py --input results/sage-low-degree-depth-forty-three-20261009/candidates-delta.json --ells 3,5,11,13 --target-depth 45 --max-new-nodes 2000 --output results/sage-low-degree-depth-forty-five-20261009/candidates-delta.json

claim_boundary: A null result means not found within prime degrees 3, 5, 11, and 13 through depth 45. It is not a complete class-group enumeration and does not refute unknown algorithms or formula families. The depth-25, depth-34, depth-36, depth-37, and two depth-42 exploratory positives remain separate open isolation follow-ups.
